youtube.title: A Killer's Code, Cracked After 51 Years | The Zodiac 340 Cipher
youtube.description:
In November 1969 the Zodiac Killer mailed a 340-symbol cipher to the San Francisco Chronicle. For 51 years nobody could read it. In December 2020, three amateur codebreakers, David Oranchak (Virginia), Jarl Van Eycke (Belgium) and Sam Blake (Australia), cracked it, and the FBI confirmed the solution. It reads: "I hope you are having lots of fun in trying to catch me... I am not afraid of the gas chamber." It gives no name. The killer has never been identified.

📂 Case File #015: The Zodiac 340

Sources: CNN, "The Zodiac Killer's 340 cipher has been solved" (Dec 2020); FBI San Francisco statement.
Images: SFPD composite sketch (public domain); Z340 cipher key by Shāntián Tàiláng, CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikimedia Commons).
Narration voice: AI.
